label: miso 67 stgas p25
definition: miso-67 (main) -- ST_GAS p25-LEVEL commitment floor: the miso-66 keeper recipe with the st_gas_mustrun_per_plant floor LEVEL swapped from the committed tranche (P5-of-online = LSL) to the plant's measured p25-of-online available-CF x nameplate (thermal_tranches_MISO.csv p25_cf; same frozen estimator, same window, same mechanism id -- rule 19 level replace). The measured 25th-percentile dispatch level of the Entergy MISO-South VLR steam fleet (Sabine 32.9%, Harding Street 36.7%, Nine Mile 49.4%), which ran 30-67% CF despite local LMP at/below SRMC (out-of-market VLR -- Amite South / DSG / WOTAB, MISO SOM). Zero fitted scalars. base = unchanged-recipe same-box drift control (mechanism-only = main - base). No ablation twin (rule 20 amended 2026-07-14). Design: docs/handoffs/miso-run66-triage-design-2026-07.md Issue-2.
market_story: One measured layer on the miso-66 recipe, zero fitted parameters: MISO-South Entergy steam plants (Sabine, Harding Street, Nine Mile, Lewis Creek) ran 30-67% of capacity through 2023-2025 even when the local price sat at or below their fuel cost - out-of-market voltage-and-local-reliability commitments the MISO market monitor documents (Amite South / DSG / WOTAB). The miso-66 floor held them only at their minimum-stable-load (the 5th-percentile of when-online output); this run swaps that level to each plants measured 25th-percentile-of-online output (the thermal-tranche artifacts p25_cf x nameplate, the same frozen CAMPD estimator - no deriver touch, no tuned scalar). Mechanism-only vs a same-box unchanged-recipe replica: ST_GAS steam generation rises +2.3/+2.3/+3.2 TWh across 2023/24/25, flipping the ST_GAS-2024 fuel-mix miss from FAIL (-8.65) to PASS (-6.37); coal/CC/CT give up only 0.5-1.8 TWh (all stay in band); the price-shape veto holds (2025 NRMSE 0.187 <= 0.20, mechanism +0.007). The forced share climbs above the 30%% budget (to 48%% in 2025) but GROUNDS clean on shape + window (D-1 diurnal r 0.98, D-4 zero off-window binding) - the NYISO reliability-base precedent. The overall grade stays NOT-YET: on current main the same-box base already fails CC_REGULAR-2023 (a code-drift regression vs the miso-66 solve commit, not this mechanism), and the July North-South price separation this was hoped to unlock proved negligible (spread 0.33 -> 0.42 vs the measured ~21). The VLR level is real and belongs in; the remaining MISO misses are a separate current-main regression and the deferred max-gen event tail.
